from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional
import dacite
@dataclass
class Topic:
    """
    A Topic is a Concept/Class/Thing/Entity
    """
    pageTitle:str
    name:Optional[str] # The name of the topic
    pluralName:Optional[str] # The plural of a topic name. E.g. for the topic 'City' the pluralName is 'Cities'. If no pluralName is specified an 's' is appended. E.g. for the topic 'Book' the default pluralName is 'Books'
    isA:Optional[str] # The metamodel kind of the topic
    extends:Optional[str] # this topic specializes the topic it extends (if any)
    icon:Optional[str] # an Icon for the topic
    iconUrl:Optional[str] # the url of an icon
    documentation:Optional[str] # The plaintext documentation of a Topic. Please do not use markup for this.
    wikiDocumentation:Optional[str] # Documentation of the Topic using MediaWiki / Semantic Mediawiki markup
    defaultstoremode:Optional[str] # The default storemode of the topic
    listLimit:Optional[float] # What is the default #ask list limit for this Topic?
    cargo:Optional[bool] # Should the Topic be stored using the [https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Extension:Cargo Cargo Extension?]
    headerTabs:Optional[bool] # shall the forms be generated with header tabs?
    context:Optional[str] # the context this topic belongs to

    @classmethod
    def askQuery(cls):
        """
        get the ask Query for Topic

        Returns:
            str: the mediawiki markup for the ask query
        """
        ask="""{{#ask: [[Concept:Topic]]
|mainlabel=pageTitle
|?Topic name = name
|?Topic pluralName = pluralName
|?Topic isA = isA
|?Topic extends = extends
|?Topic icon = icon
|?Topic iconUrl = iconUrl
|?Topic documentation = documentation
|?Topic wikiDocumentation = wikiDocumentation
|?Topic defaultstoremode = defaultstoremode
|?Topic listLimit = listLimit
|?Topic cargo = cargo
|?Topic headerTabs = headerTabs
|?Topic context = context
|limit=10000
|format=table
|sort=Topic name
|order=ascending
}}"""
        return ask

    @classmethod
    def fromDict(cls,data:dict):
        """
        create a Topic from the given dict

        Args:
            data(dict): the dict to create the Topic from

        Returns:
            Topic: the freshly created Topic
        """
        topic=dacite.from_dict(data_class=cls,data=data)
        return topic
